title: Japan's Aura Seeker (ME7) lands Fri 27 Nov, three days away
detail: Serebii lists Japanese release on 27 Nov with 78 base cards: Mega Lucario Z ex (57, alt 110), Mega Absol Z ex (30), Mega Garchomp Z ex (67), Mega Glimmora ex (54), plus Single/Rapid Strike Urshifu. No English date given yet. Prices will only appear after release.

title: Champions League Chiba (22 Nov): still no result on Limitless
detail: Limitless's list still ends at São Paulo (20 Nov, winner Vinícius Fernandez). Chiba is unconfirmed. Next: Regional Stuttgart, Sat 28 Nov (per yesterday's check; not re-verified today).

title: OP-18 French events continue; official French release date still not found
detail: Play-in lists French OP-18 events (€35) on 21, 23 and 28 Nov, and English-language events on 20 and 27 Nov. English OP-18 came out 20 Nov. No official French release date found, so treat it as unconfirmed. Sortilèges' site was down (503) when checked, so no Réunion stock news today.
